overview.en: Non-degree pre-university chinese-medium preparation for international students entering the ongoing cohort in February 2027. Subject-preparation tracks: Science, Engineering & Agriculture; Medicine; and Humanities & Social Sciences.

qualification.en: Non-degree extension programme; not related to a credit or degree.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese is the primary language of instruction. HSK Level 5 total at least 200 with Writing at least 60, or an equivalent certificate such as documentation of Chinese as a native language.

curriculumHighlights.en: Mathematics, language and academic-skills development, cultural activities and progression counseling.
Three preparation tracks: Science, Engineering & Agriculture; Medicine; and Humanities & Social Sciences; choose one or two major electives and one general elective per semester.

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid foreign passport, satisfying Ministry of Education rules including Document No. 12 (2020).
Good physical and mental health and no criminal record.
Age at least 16 and strictly under 23.

Spring entry is a limited mid-term transfer opportunity for outstanding students into the ongoing one-year cohort; admission is subject to comprehensive review and an integrative test or interview when applicable.
HSK Level 5 total at least 200 with Writing at least 60, or an equivalent certificate such as documentation of Chinese as a native language.

applicationMaterials.en: Senior high school diploma or equivalent. The notice permits prospective graduates to provide an official high school transcript as proof of graduation.
High school profile covering the school introduction, admission requirements, enrollment rate, curriculum, grading system and university destinations of graduates.
Passport information page valid for more than six months. Passport information may not change after admission until registration is completed.
Color, hat-free portrait photograph.
Signed personal statement of 600–1000 words covering background, interests and strengths, reasons for applying and study plans.
One signed recommendation letter with the recommender’s email address and telephone number.
High school transcript covering all courses; prospective graduates provide all course results completed by the application date.

Standardized international tests or national/regional school-leaving or university-entrance results, such as SAT, AP, ACT, A-Level, IB or UEC. A written explanation may be submitted if these results cannot be provided.
Applicant’s birth certificate.
Nationality or household-registration evidence for both parents, such as passports or identity cards.

Where one or both parents are Chinese citizens: proof of the applicant’s foreign nationality obtained at birth or subsequently. If foreign nationality was acquired at birth and a Chinese parent was permanently resident abroad at that time, provide the parent’s permanent-residence evidence.

If foreign nationality was acquired at birth but the Chinese parent or parents were not permanently resident abroad, provide proof of renunciation of Chinese nationality for at least four years by April 30 of the application year. Former Chinese citizens who later acquired foreign nationality provide cancellation of Chinese household registration and renunciation of Chinese nationality for at least four years by April 30 of the application year. Confirm the applicable application-year reference with SJTU.

For the Chinese-parent nationality cases: all Chinese visas, residence permits and entry/exit records starting with the first passport, plus a Statement of Integrity. Previous holders of a PRC Travel Document or PRC Exit and Entry Permit supply the former-Chinese-citizen documentation specified in section 11.3.
Guardian Guarantee Form for spring applicants who are under 18 as of February 1, 2027, inclusive of that reference date.
Award certificates, if any, and any other supporting materials requested by SJTU.

Documents in languages other than Chinese or English require notarized Chinese or English translations. Paper supporting documents are not required during application. All information must be authentic, accurate and complete or application, enrollment or study eligibility is canceled.
HSK Level 5 total at least 200 with Writing at least 60, or an equivalent certificate such as documentation of Chinese as a native language.

campus.en: Qibao Campus, 2678 Qixin Road, Minhang District, Shanghai.

notes.en: Spring registration is in mid-February 2027; the exact date will appear in the Admission Notice. The 0.5-year route is one semester joining the ongoing one-year cohort, with limited places for outstanding mid-term transfer students. The curriculum table lists the second semester as 10 weeks including examinations. Each language route offers three subject tracks: science, engineering and agriculture; medicine; and humanities and social sciences. Listed undergraduate majors describe future study interests. Admission to a bachelor programme requires its own assessment; the notice describes priority after passing the official assessment. The curriculum may change for progression requirements and student ability; select one or two major electives and one general elective each semester. Applications receive comprehensive review and may require an integrative test or interview, with arrangements emailed. Pay the non-refundable CNY800 application fee before submitting. After pre-admission, confirm enrollment by paying tuition within two weeks. Spring Admission Notices are issued in batches from the end of January. Download the electronic notice from the application system; paper copies are supplied at registration. Tuition includes CSCA preparation, HSK mock examinations and undergraduate application guidance. Group Comprehensive Insurance in Mainland China is required for registration; the published standard is CNY800 per academic year. Qibao Campus guarantees university-assigned four-person accommodation at CNY700 per month. At least ten students must enroll in each programme; otherwise the programme is canceled and tuition refunded in full. Freshman Scholarships are restricted to new one-year autumn-start students. Outstanding Student Scholarships depend on semester examination results; scholarships cannot be applied to tuition fees. False, inaccurate or incomplete application information can cancel application, enrollment or study eligibility. Check the nationality documentation and spring guardian reference date in the application checklist.

Otherwise, the applicant will be disqualified forapplication, enrollment or study. 1. Senior highschool diploma or equivalent qualification. One recommendation letter, signedby the recommender and including their contact information (email address and phonenumber). 7. Academic certificates: 7.1 High school transcript(covering all courses completed during high school). Prospective graduates mustsubmit a transcript of all high school courses completed up to the applicationdate. 7.2 Standardized internationaltest scores or national/regional unified high school graduation or universityentrance exam results, such as SAT, AP, ACT, A-Level, IB, UEC, etc. If theabove results cannot be provided, a written explanation can be submitted. 8. Language certificate: 8.1 Chinese Program (1 year) applicants should provide HSKcertificate (HSK 4 score ≥ 180) or equivalentcertificate. Chinese Program (0.5 year) applicants should provide HSKcertificate (HSK 5 score ≥ 200, with Writing score ≥ 60) or equivalent certificate, such as documentation indicating Chineseas a native language. 8.2 English Program (1 year) applicants should provide oneof the following: • TOEFL score report (totalscore ≥ 80) • IELTS score report (totalscore ≥ 5.5) • Proof of being a nativeEnglish speaker • Certificate of at least twoyears of full-time academic study conducted in English English Program (0.5 year) applicants should provideone of the following: • TOEFL score report (totalscore ≥ 90) • IELTS score report (total score ≥ 6.0) • Proof of being a native English speaker • Certificate of at least two years of full-timeacademic study conducted in English 9. Applicant's birth certificate. 10. The nationality or householdregistration of both the applicant's parents, such as passport or ID card. 11. Applicant whose one or bothparents are Chinese citizens should provide the following materials: 11.1 Certificate of theapplicant’s foreign nationality obtained at birth or afterward. 11.2 For applicants whoacquired foreign nationality at birth: (a) If one or both parentswere Chinese citizens and had permanent residence abroad at the time of theapplicant's birth, provide the corresponding permanent residence proof of theparent(s). (b) If one or both parentswere Chinese citizens and did not have permanent residence abroad at the timeof the applicant's birth, provide a certificate of the applicant's renunciationof Chinese nationality for at least four years by April 30 of the applicationyear. 11.3 For applicants who areoriginally Chinese citizens and later acquired foreign nationality, provideproof of cancellation of their Chinese residence registration and renunciationof Chinese nationality for at least four years by April 30 of the applicationyear. 11.4 All visas, residencepermits, and entry/exit records for China, starting from the applicant's firstpassport. 11.5 Statement of Integrity Note: Applicants whopreviously held a "People's Republic of China Travel Document" or"People's Republic of China Exit and Entry Permit" must provide therelevant documentation as in section 11.3. 12. Applicants under the age of 18as of September 1, 2026 (inclusive) for the Fall intake, or as of February 1,2027 (inclusive) for the Spring intake, must submit a Guardian Guarantee Form. 13. Award certificates (if any). 14. Other supportive materialsrequired by SJTU. Note: 1 If any documents are not inChinese or English, notarized translations in either language are required. 2 Hard copies of supportingmaterials are not necessary during the application process.
